title: Order Tracking & Status
content: Customers can track their orders by logging into their account, navigating to 'My Orders', and clicking the 'Track Package' button next to their recent order. If a customer asks 'where is my order' or 'track my order', direct them to their account page.

title: Delayed Orders
content: If an order is delayed, explain that weather conditions or high carrier volumes can sometimes cause a 1-2 day delay. If the order has been delayed for more than 3 days past the expected delivery date, ask the customer to provide their order number so customer care can investigate.

title: Returns and Refunds Policy
content: We offer a 7-day return policy for all unused items in their original packaging. Once we receive the returned item, refunds will be processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method. Final sale and clearance items are not eligible for return.

title: Shipping Information
content: We offer Standard Shipping (5-7 business days) for $5.99, and Express Shipping (2-3 business days) for $14.99. Orders over $50 qualify for free Standard Shipping. We currently ship domestically and to select international locations.

title: Payment Methods & Issues
content: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and UPI. If a payment fails but money was deducted, assure the customer the transaction will automatically reverse within 3-5 business days. For declined payments, suggest contacting their bank or trying another card.

title: Product Information & Availability
content: We sell a wide range of electronics (including laptops, smartphones, and wireless headphones) and clothing. To check specific stock, colors, or prices (like the iPhone 14 or laptops under 50,000), instruct the user to use the search bar at the top of the website to view current live inventory and pricing.

title: Account Management & Password Reset
content: To reset a password, users should go to the login page, click 'Forgot Password', and follow the instructions sent to their registered email address. Users can update their shipping and billing addresses in the 'Account Settings' page.

title: Product Quality & Warranty
content: All our electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer's warranty covering defects. Clothing and accessories are guaranteed against manufacturing defects for 90 days from the date of purchase. If a product arrives damaged or missing parts, ask them to contact support with photos within 48 hours for an immediate replacement.

title: Order Cancellations
content: Orders can be canceled within 1 hour of placement. Please navigate to 'My Orders' and click 'Cancel Order'. If the option is no longer available, the order has already been processed for delivery.

title: Contact Human Agent
content: If a user explicitly asks to speak to customer care, is angry about service, or has a complex issue (like receiving the wrong item), apologize for the inconvenience and tell them you are transferring them to customer care. (Simulate this by providing a support email: support@example.com or phone: 1-800-123-4567).
